manifest.name: Mumbot Music
manifest.description: Control a mumbot music bot in your channel: now playing, skip, volume, queue and adding tracks.
not_in_channel: Mumbot is not in your channel
no_certificate: This user has no certificate, so Mumcord can't recognise it as a bot again.
bot_kept: Your saved address and key are kept.
key_label_edit: New API key (leave empty to keep the current one)
add_label: Add a file name or URL
remove_confirm: Remove this bot and its API key?
no_bots: No bots yet. Right-click a bot in your channel and choose Configure bot.
plain_http: Plain http is only allowed for local addresses
bad_certificate: The bot's certificate is not valid
bot_disconnected: The bot is not connected to the server
redirect: The bot answered with a redirect, which is not followed
enter_both: Enter the address and the API key first
answer_too_large: The bot's answer was too large
http_400: The bot refused this: not an MP3 or an invalid request
http_403: Not allowed: this key can't play there, or that URL or host is not allowed
http_404: Not found: check the file name
http_502: The bot couldn't download that URL
status_error: The bot answered with an error (status {{status}})
not_mumbot: That address does not answer like a mumbot
address_label: Bot address (IP or domain, with port)
setup_intro: This bot is not set up yet. Enter the address of its music API and an API key from the bot owner.
setup_intro_edit: Change the address or the API key of this bot.
address_note_http: http:// to a private address. Traffic is not encrypted.
setup_footer: Saved for this bot only. The key goes into your system keychain and is never shown again.
not_in_channel_body: The music controls are only available while the bot is in the same channel as you. They come back by themselves when it returns.
remove_note: Removing deletes the address and the key from this computer.
